preconditions.description: A and B are positive integers not exceeding 20.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == B for line in picture)
preconditions.description: Each line of the picture has exactly B symbols.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.isupper() for c in line) for line in picture)
preconditions.description: Each symbol in the picture is an uppercase English letter.

postconditions.description: The output is a tuple with two elements.
The first element of the output is a positive integer representing the number of good puzzles.
The second element of the output is a tuple with two integers representing the sizes X and Y of the smallest possible element.

postconditions.expression: return_value[1][0] * return_value[1][1] == min(X * Y for X, Y in good_puzzles)
postconditions.description: The area of the smallest possible element is minimized.

postconditions.expression: return_value[1][0] <= min(X for X, Y in good_puzzles if X * Y == return_value[1][0] * return_value[1][1])
postconditions.description: Among elements with the smallest area, the length X is minimized.
